scripts.start: echo 'PRODUCTION | Starting stream-cam idle servers...' && ENVIRONMENT=PRODUCTION FORCE=FALSE bun server.ts & ENVIRONMENT=PRODUCTION FORCE=FALSE bun uiServer.ts &
scripts.start:force: echo 'PRODUCTION | Starting stream-cam servers (forced)...' && ENVIRONMENT=PRODUCTION FORCE=TRUE bun server.ts & ENVIRONMENT=PRODUCTION FORCE=TRUE bun uiServer.ts &
scripts.start:backend: echo 'PRODUCTION | Starting stream-cam backend server...' && ENVIRONMENT=PRODUCTION bun server.ts
scripts.start:ui: echo 'PRODUCTION | Starting stream-cam UI server...' && ENVIRONMENT=PRODUCTION bun uiServer.ts
scripts.dev: echo 'DEVELOPMENT | Starting stream-cam idle servers...' && ENVIRONMENT=DEVELOPMENT FORCE=FALSE bun server.ts & ENVIRONMENT=DEVELOPMENT FORCE=FALSE bun uiServer.ts &
scripts.dev:force: echo 'DEVELOPMENT | Starting stream-cam servers (forced)...' && ENVIRONMENT=DEVELOPMENT FORCE=TRUE bun server.ts & ENVIRONMENT=DEVELOPMENT FORCE=TRUE bun uiServer.ts &
scripts.dev:backend: echo 'DEVELOPMENT | Starting stream-cam backend server...' && ENVIRONMENT=DEVELOPMENT bun server.ts
scripts.dev:ui: echo 'DEVELOPMENT | Starting stream-cam UI server...' && ENVIRONMENT=DEVELOPMENT bun uiServer.ts
scripts.stop: echo 'Stopping stream-cam servers...' && sudo fuser -k 20240/tcp & sudo fuser -k 80/tcp
scripts.stop:backend: echo 'Stopping stream-cam backend server...' && sudo fuser -k 20240/tcp
scripts.stop:ui: echo 'Stopping stream-cam UI server...' && sudo fuser -k 80/tcp
scripts.stop-mac: echo 'Stopping stream-cam servers...' && lsof -i tcp:20240 | awk 'NR!=1 {print $2}' | xargs -r kill & lsof -i tcp:80 | awk 'NR!=1 {print $2}' | xargs -r kill
scripts.stop-mac:backend: echo 'Stopping stream-cam backend server...' && lsof -i tcp:20240 | awk 'NR!=1 {print $2}' | xargs -r kill
scripts.stop-mac:ui: echo 'Stopping stream-cam UI server...' && lsof -i tcp:80 | awk 'NR!=1 {print $2}' | xargs -r kill
